title: Fracture fixation basics
summary: Reduce and fix a tibial shaft fracture: instruments and principles.

steps.title: WHO Time Out
steps.prompt: Before skin incision for fixation of the right tibia, the team pauses. What must be confirmed aloud?

choices.text: Patient identity, the procedure, the site and side, and antibiotics given in the last 60 minutes
choices.feedback: Correct: the Time Out confirms who, what and where, and that prophylaxis is in.

choices.text: Only that the consent form is signed
choices.feedback: The signature alone does not prevent wrong-site surgery.

choices.text: Nothing: the site was marked on the ward
choices.feedback: Marking does not replace the Time Out.

steps.hint: The site is the right leg. All three phases of the WHO checklist are mandatory.

steps.title: Pick up the skin preparation
steps.hint: Alcoholic chlorhexidine, applied from the incision site outwards.

steps.title: Prepare the skin over the right shin
steps.hint: Centre outwards, wider than the incision; let it dry fully before drapes and diathermy (it is flammable).

steps.title: Describe
steps.prompt: How should a fracture be described?

choices.text: Bone, location, pattern, displacement, and the state of the skin

choices.feedback: Mechanism helps but doesn't describe the fracture.

steps.title: Strip the periosteum minimally with the raspatory
Reduce with the bone clamp
steps.hint: Clamp across the fracture to hold the reduction.

steps.title: Drill the screw hole
steps.hint: Drill with a guide; measure with the depth gauge.

steps.title: Drill across the fracture
steps.hint: Perpendicular to the fracture for a lag screw.

steps.title: Stability
steps.prompt: A lag screw and plate give…

choices.text: Absolute stability with primary bone healing

choices.feedback: That is a nail or cast.
